high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "marketingstudies." The post features two individuals shaking hands in front of flags. The person on the left appears to be wearing a dark suit with a tie, while the person on the right is dressed in a light-colored kurta. Both individuals are smiling and seem to be engaged in a formal or diplomatic interaction. The background includes the flags of Afghanistan and India. The Afghan flag has a red star in the center, while the Indian flag displays the Ashoka Chakra in the middle of the white band.
